Subject: Scriptwriter opening at Lumen Media

Hi all,

We are looking for a scriptwriter to join our education content team. You would be writing explainer scripts for our YouTube channel, working closely with the research team, and shaping the voice of the brand. The ideal candidate loves simplifying complex topics and has written for video before.

Compensation is 3–3.6 LPA depending on experience. This is a full-time role.

Apply by 15 August with two writing samples.
